scopes: Heap means Godot tracked static allocations for held decoded data, not OS RSS or total game RAM.
Three fresh processes per load case; OS caches not evicted, so load times are not cold disk or network measurements.
Adaptive tolerances are measured control-point errors against the saved120Hz reference, not a mesh-vertex or new physical-simulation guarantee.
Sparse flags and failure timestamps retain the original120Hz reference semantics. Other continuous floating state is stored asFloat32.
